violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface * was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. . Refrigerator door handle broken and temporary fixed with duct tape.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned as frequently as required. . Clean in place equipment dirty and greasy in the kitchen food prep area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floors, walls, and ceiling has an accumulation of dirt and grease in the kitchen and food prep area.

Nonfood-contact surfaces - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not designed and/or constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. - Door handle on refrigerator broken.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned adequately. - Cabinet faces require more frequent cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Ceiling vent above microwave dusty. - Floors and walls could use a deep cleaning.
Lighting. — --Existing light fixtures * did not provide adequate illumination. - 2 lights in kitchen broken. - light cover over food prep broken.
